&lt;hr data-start="4787" data-end="4790"&gt;
&lt;p data-start="4792" data-end="4819"&gt;Let me know if you want to:&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;ul data-start="4820" data-end="5054"&gt;
&lt;li data-start="4820" data-end="4872"&gt;
&lt;p data-start="4822" data-end="4872"&gt;Add &lt;strong data-start="4826" data-end="4840"&gt;timestamps&lt;/strong&gt;, owners, or durations per task.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li data-start="4873" data-end="4932"&gt;
&lt;p data-start="4875" data-end="4932"&gt;Create a &lt;strong data-start="4884" data-end="4902"&gt;status tracker&lt;/strong&gt; (Kanban/Markdown checkboxes).&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li data-start="4933" data-end="4994"&gt;
&lt;p data-start="4935" data-end="4994"&gt;Generate a &lt;strong data-start="4946" data-end="4967"&gt;project README.md&lt;/strong&gt; or &lt;code data-start="4971" data-end="4984"&gt;.toml/.json&lt;/code&gt; manifest.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li data-start="4995" data-end="5054"&gt;
&lt;p data-start="4997" data-end="5054"&gt;Bundle this as a &lt;strong data-start="5014" data-end="5038"&gt;Cargo crate manifest&lt;/strong&gt; for &lt;code data-start="5043" data-end="5053"&gt;build.rs&lt;/code&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;
&lt;p data-start="5056" data-end="5171" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node=""&gt;This is turning into a great foundation for decentralized task management with semantically rich emoji scaffolding.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span></span>

line-height: 1.5; tab-size: 4; hyphens: none;"><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Title</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>: Implement LLM-Driven Task Prioritization and Suggestions
</span>
<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Description</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:  
</span>Integrate an LLM-based suggestion engine to analyze task dependencies, code activity, and completion rates, providing recommendations for next actions, task splitting/merging, and bottleneck detection. This will reduce project management overhead and adapt to team velocity.

<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Tasks</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Build data hooks for real-time task status, dependency health, and user interactions.
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Expose data to an LLM (e.g., OpenAI or local model).
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Generate actionable suggestions (e.g., "Split 📐🔄📊 due to long delay" or "Merge 📈🔗📊 and 📤📈📑").
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Display suggestions in the UI or as a "Task Suggestions" feed.
</span>
<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Dependencies</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:  
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> 📝📈🔗 (Structured tasks into collapsible HTML sections)
</span>

</span>
<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Description</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:  
</span>Create a web-based (Dioxus/React) dashboard to visualize the task graph in real time, allowing filtering by status/group/priority and drag-and-drop task reprioritization or reassignment. Edits will sync with the semantic graph and project workflow.

<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Tasks</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Extend backend to provide a JSON/GraphQL API for the task graph.
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Develop a UI with node-link diagram (Mermaid/Cytoscape/custom).
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Enable filtering, search, and drag-and-drop for dependencies/priorities.
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Sync UI edits to the backend with optimistic updates and conflict resolution.
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Add critical path highlighting and bulk operation actions.
</span>
<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Dependencies</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:

content">Title</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>: Implement LLM-Driven Task Prioritization and Suggestions
</span>
<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Description</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:  
</span>Integrate an LLM-based suggestion engine to analyze task dependencies, code activity, and completion rates, providing recommendations for next actions, task splitting/merging, and bottleneck detection. This will reduce project management overhead and adapt to team velocity.

<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Tasks</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Build data hooks for real-time task status, dependency health, and user interactions.
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Expose data to an LLM (e.g., OpenAI or local model).
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Generate actionable suggestions (e.g., "Split 📐🔄📊 due to long delay" or "Merge 📈🔗📊 and 📤📈📑").
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Display suggestions in the UI or as a "Task Suggestions" feed.
</span>
<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Dependencies</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:

</span>
<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Description</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:  
</span>Create a web-based (Dioxus/React) dashboard to visualize the task graph in real time, allowing filtering by status/group/priority and drag-and-drop task reprioritization or reassignment. Edits will sync with the semantic graph and project workflow.

<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Tasks</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:

</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Develop a UI with node-link diagram (Mermaid/Cytoscape/custom).
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Enable filtering, search, and drag-and-drop for dependencies/priorities.
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Sync UI edits to the backend with optimistic updates and conflict resolution.
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Add critical path highlighting and bulk operation actions.
</span>

</span>
<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Description</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:  
</span><span>Develop a module to load the project’s </span><span class="token code-snippet code" style="color: rgb(86, 156, 214);">`.ttl`</span><span> ontology, vectorize sum/group concepts, enrich unknown terms with the 3 closest emojis using a similarity model, and output to RDF with a progress bar for UX.
</span>
<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Tasks</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Parse Turtle ontology into memory.
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Identify and vectorize sum/group concepts.
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Find 3 closest emoji matches for unknown terms.
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Serialize vectors and emoji tags to RDF (Turtle).
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Implement progress bar for vectorization.
</span>
<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Dependencies</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:

word-spacing: normal; word-break: normal; line-height: 1.5; tab-size: 4; hyphens: none;"><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Title</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>: Implement Vector Cache &amp; Ontology Reuse
</span>
<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Description</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:  
</span>Enable caching of vectorized concepts and emoji mappings in RDF for reuse, with CLI/GUI export capabilities to support downstream ML or visualization tasks.

<span></span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span class="token bold content">Tasks</span><span class="token bold" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">**</span><span>:
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Check cache for existing vectors before recomputation.
</span><span></span><span class="token list" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> [ ] Merge new vectors and emoji tags into RDF ontology.

Key Feature: Embedding hash-based deduplication to avoid redundant computations.

Rust-Specific Adjustments
Cargo Crate: Bundle core logic as a library (task_manager_core) with CLI binaries (task-cli)
Build System: Use build.rs to generate task manifests from ontology files
Dioxus: If you want a GUI dashboard, Dioxus + tao for desktop (or wasm-bindgen for web)
Gantt Chart: Use plotters crate for static visualizations or yew for interactive web rendering

</span></span><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">### **2. Scaffold Full Cargo Workspace**

</span><span></span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(220, 220, 170);">mkdir</span><span> -p task_manager/</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">{</span><span>task_manager_core,task_cli,task_dashboard</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">}</span><span>

</span>
<span></span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(106, 153, 85);"># Initialize crates</span><span>
</span>cargo init --lib task_manager_core
cargo init --bin task_cli
cargo init --bin task_dashboard

<span></span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(106, 153, 85);"># Update Cargo.toml</span><span>
</span><span></span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(220, 220, 170);">cat</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">&lt;&lt;</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">EOT</span><span class="token bash" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);"> </span><span class="token bash" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">&gt;</span><span class="token bash" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);"> Cargo.toml</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">[workspace]
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">members = ["task_manager_core", "task_cli", "task_dashboard"]
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">[package]
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">name = "task_manager_core"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">version = "0.1.0"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">edition = "2021"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">[dependencies]
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">oxrdf = "0.2"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">tch = { version = "0.17", features = ["onnx"] }
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">indicatif = "0.17"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">serde_json = "1.0"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">anyhow = "1.0"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">clap = { version = "4.5", features = ["derive"] }
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">tokio = { version = "1.40", features = ["full"] }
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">rusqlite = "0.28"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">EOT</span></code></pre></div></div><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1adg3ll r-1g7jtus r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">**File scaffolding**</span></span><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">:  </span></span></span></span><div class="css-175oi2r r-1adg3ll r-ag158w r-dnmrzs r-1yx7oqi r-13qz1uu"><div class="css-175oi2r r-dnmrzs r-1adg3ll r-13qz1uu" data-testid="markdown-code-block"><div class="css-175oi2r r-1awozwy r-1fkb3t2 r-1fs5b29 r-1idry7j r-6413gk r-43g30s r-l4nmg1 r-1u658rm r-2dysd3 r-vmopo1 r-13qz1uu r-gtdqiz r-1fhadnw r-184en5c"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1aiqnjv r-n6v787"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">rust</span></span><div class="css-175oi2r r-xoduu5 r-1ybcz0z"></div></div><pre style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212); </span><span>    gh project </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(220, 220, 170);">column</span><span> create </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">"Task Manager Kanban"</span><span> --name </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">"</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(156, 220, 254);">$col</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">"</span><span>

</span>

</span><span></span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(86, 156, 214);">for</span><span> </span><span class="token for-or-select" style="color: rgb(156, 220, 254);">issue</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(86, 156, 214);">in</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(156, 220, 254);">$(</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(156, 220, 254);">gh issue list -L </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(181, 206, 168);">6</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(156, 220, 254);"> -q </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">"is:issue is:open"</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(156, 220, 254);"> --json number </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">|</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(156, 220, 254);"> jq -r </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">'.[].number'</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(156, 220, 254);">)</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">;</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(86, 156, 214);">do</span><span>

</span></span><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">### **2. Scaffold Full Cargo Workspace**  
</span></span><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1adg3ll r-1g7jtus r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">Here’s the directory structure and files to initialize the project:  </span></span></span></span><div class="css-175oi2r r-1adg3ll r-ag158w r-dnmrzs r-1yx7oqi r-13qz1uu"><div class="css-175oi2r r-dnmrzs r-1adg3ll r-13qz1uu" data-testid="markdown-code-block"><div class="css-175oi2r r-1awozwy r-1fkb3t2 r-1fs5b29 r-1idry7j r-6413gk r-43g30s r-l4nmg1 r-1u658rm r-2dysd3 r-vmopo1 r-13qz1uu r-gtdqiz r-1fhadnw r-184en5c"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1aiqnjv r-n6v787"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">bash</span></span><div class="css-175oi2r r-xoduu5 r-1ybcz0z"></div></div><pre style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212); font-size: 13px; text-shadow: none; font-family: monospace; direction: ltr; text-align: left; white-space: pre; word-spacing: normal; word-break: normal; line-height: 1.3; tab-size: 4; hyphens: none; padding: 12px; margin: 0px 0px 0.5em; overflow: auto; background: rgb(22, 24, 28); display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border-bottom-left-radius: 8px; border-bottom-right-radius: 8px;"><code class="language-bash" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212); font-size: 13px; text-shadow: none; font-family: Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Andale Mono&quot;, &quot;Ubuntu Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; direction: ltr; text-align: left; white-space: pre; word-spacing: normal; word-break: normal; line-height: 1.5; tab-size: 4; hyphens: none;"><span class="token" style="color: rgb(106, 153, 85);"># Create workspace</span><span>
</span><span></span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(220, 220, 170);">mkdir</span><span> -p task_manager/</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">{</span><span>task_manager_core,task_cli,task_dashboard</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">}</span><span>
</span><span></span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(78, 201, 176);">cd</span><span> task_manager
</span>
<span></span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(106, 153, 85);"># Initialize crates</span><span>
</span>cargo init --lib task_manager_core
cargo init --bin task_cli
cargo init --bin task_dashboard

<span></span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(106, 153, 85);"># Update Cargo.toml</span><span>
</span><span></span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(220, 220, 170);">cat</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">&lt;&lt;</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">EOT</span><span class="token bash" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);"> </span><span class="token bash" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">&gt;</span><span class="token bash" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);"> Cargo.toml</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">[workspace]
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">members = ["task_manager_core", "task_cli", "task_dashboard"]
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">[package]
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">name = "task_manager_core"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">version = "0.1.0"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">edition = "2021"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">[dependencies]
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">oxrdf = "0.2"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">tch = { version = "0.17", features = ["onnx"] }
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">indicatif = "0.17"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">serde_json = "1.0"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">anyhow = "1.0"
</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">clap = { version = "4.5", features = ["derive"] }

</span><span></span><span class="token prefix" style="color: rgb(220, 220, 170);">ex</span><span class="token prefix" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span class="token local-name" style="color: rgb(220, 220, 170);">task5</span><span> </span><span class="token prefix" style="color: rgb(220, 220, 170);">ex</span><span class="token prefix" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span class="token local-name" style="color: rgb(220, 220, 170);">hasLabel</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">"Run unit tests"</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">;</span><span> hasEmojiTag </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">"🧪"</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">,</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">"✅"</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">,</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">"🔍"</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">.</span></code></pre></div></div><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">#### **Step 4: Validate Cache Behavior**

</span><span></span><span class="token assign-left" style="color: rgb(156, 220, 254);">OPENAI_API_KEY</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">=</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">"your-api-key"</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">\</span><span>
</span><span>cargo run --bin task_cli </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">\</span><span>
</span><span>  --input project.ttl </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">\</span><span>
</span><span>  --output vectorized2.ttl </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">\</span><span>
</span><span>  --emoji-dict emoji.json </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">\</span><span>

</span><span>  --chunk-size </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(181, 206, 168);">2</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">\</span><span>
</span>  --llm-api openai

<span></span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(106, 153, 85);"># Check cache hit rate</span><span>
</span><span>sqlite3 vector_cache.db </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM embeddings;"</span></code></pre></div></div><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">---

</span></span><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">### **2. GitHub Projects Kanban Sync**  
</span></span><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1adg3ll r-1g7jtus r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">Here’s a refined GitHub Actions workflow to auto-assign issues to Kanban columns based on emoji tags:</span></span></span></span><div class="css-175oi2r r-1adg3ll r-ag158w r-dnmrzs r-1yx7oqi r-13qz1uu"><div class="css-175oi2r r-dnmrzs r-1adg3ll r-13qz1uu" data-testid="markdown-code-block"><div class="css-175oi2r r-1awozwy r-1fkb3t2 r-1fs5b29 r-1idry7j r-6413gk r-43g30s r-l4nmg1 r-1u658rm r-2dysd3 r-vmopo1 r-13qz1uu r-gtdqiz r-1fhadnw r-184en5c"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1aiqnjv r-n6v787"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">yaml</span></span><div class="css-175oi2r r-xoduu5 r-1ybcz0z"></div></div><pre style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212); font-size: 13px; text-shadow: none; font-family: monospace; direction: ltr; text-align: left; white-space: pre; word-spacing: normal; word-break: normal; line-height: 1.3; tab-size: 4; hyphens: none; padding: 12px; margin: 0px 0px 0.5em; overflow: auto; background: rgb(22, 24, 28); display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border-bottom-left-radius: 8px; border-bottom-right-radius: 8px;"><code class="language-yaml" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212); font-size: 13px; text-shadow: none; font-family: Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Andale Mono&quot;, &quot;Ubuntu Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; direction: ltr; text-align: left; white-space: pre; word-spacing: normal; word-break: normal; line-height: 1.5; tab-size: 4; hyphens: none;"><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">name</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> Sync Kanban Board
</span><span></span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">on</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span>
</span><span>  </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">issue_comment</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span>
</span><span>    </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">types</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">[</span><span>created</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">]</span><span>
</span><span></span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">jobs</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span>
</span><span>  </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">sync</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span>
</span><span>    </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">runs-on</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> ubuntu</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span>latest
</span><span>    </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">steps</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span>
</span><span>      </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">uses</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> actions/checkout@v3
</span><span>      </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">name</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> Map Emoji to Kanban Column
</span><span>        </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">id</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> emoji</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span>to</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span>column
</span><span>        </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">run</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">|</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">          # Map 🚧 → In Progress, ✅ → Done, etc.
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">          EMOJI="${{ github.event.comment.body }}"
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">          if [[ "$EMOJI" == "🚧" ]]; then
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">            echo "column=In Progress" &gt;&gt; $GITHUB_OUTPUT
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">          elif [[ "$EMOJI" == "✅" ]]; then
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">            echo "column=Done" &gt;&gt; $GITHUB_OUTPUT
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">          else
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">            echo "column=To Do" &gt;&gt; $GITHUB_OUTPUT
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">          fi</span><span>
</span><span>      </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">name</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> Update Kanban Board
</span><span>        </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">run</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">|</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">          gh project item-add "Task Manager Kanban" \
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">            --issue "${{ github.event.issue.number }}" \
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">            --column "${{ steps.emoji-to-column.outputs.column }}"</span></code></pre></div></div><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1adg3ll r-1g7jtus r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">**Usage**</span></span><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">:  </span></span></span></span><div class="css-175oi2r r-1adg3ll r-ag158w r-dnmrzs r-1yx7oqi r-13qz1uu"><div class="css-175oi2r r-dnmrzs r-1adg3ll r-13qz1uu" data-testid="markdown-code-block"><div class="css-175oi2r r-1awozwy r-1fkb3t2 r-1fs5b29 r-1idry7j r-6413gk r-43g30s r-l4nmg1 r-1u658rm r-2dysd3 r-vmopo1 r-13qz1uu r-gtdqiz r-1fhadnw r-184en5c"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1aiqnjv r-n6v787"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">bash</span></span><div class="css-175oi2r r-xoduu5 r-1ybcz0z"></div></div><pre style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212); font-size: 13px; text-shadow: none; font-family: monospace; direction: ltr; text-align: left; white-space: pre; word-spacing: normal; word-break: normal; line-height: 1.3; tab-size: 4; hyphens: none; padding: 12px; margin: 0px 0px 0.5em; overflow: auto; background: rgb(22, 24, 28); display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border-bottom-left-radius: 8px; border-bottom-right-radius: 8px;"><code class="language-bash" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212); font-size: 13px; text-shadow: none; font-family: Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Andale Mono&quot;, &quot;Ubuntu Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; direction: ltr; text-align: left; white-space: pre; word-spacing: normal; word-break: normal; line-height: 1.5; tab-size: 4; hyphens: none;"><span class="token" style="color: rgb(106, 153, 85);"># Comment on an issue to trigger Kanban update</span><span>
</span><span>gh issue comment </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(181, 206, 168);">101</span><span> --body </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">"🚧"</span></code></pre></div></div><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3 r-1x3r274"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3">---

word-spacing: normal; word-break: normal; line-height: 1.5; tab-size: 4; hyphens: none;"><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">name</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> Sync Kanban Board
</span><span></span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">on</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span>
</span><span>  </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">issue_comment</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span>
</span><span>    </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">types</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">[</span><span>created</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">]</span><span>
</span><span></span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">jobs</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span>
</span><span>  </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">sync</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span>
</span><span>    </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">runs-on</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> ubuntu</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span>latest
</span><span>    </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">steps</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span>
</span><span>      </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">uses</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> actions/checkout@v3
</span><span>      </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">name</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> Map Emoji to Column
</span><span>        </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">id</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> map
</span><span>        </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">run</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">|</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">          EMOJI="${{ github.event.comment.body }}"
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">          case "$EMOJI" in
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">            "🚧") echo "column=In Progress" &gt;&gt; $GITHUB_OUTPUT ;;
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">            "✅") echo "column=Done" &gt;&gt; $GITHUB_OUTPUT ;;
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">            *) echo "column=To Do" &gt;&gt; $GITHUB_OUTPUT ;;
</span><span class="token scalar" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">          esac</span><span>
</span><span>      </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">-</span><span> </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">name</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> Update Kanban
</span><span>        </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">env</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span>
</span><span>          </span><span class="token key" style="color: rgb(206, 145, 120);">GH_TOKEN</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">:</span><span> $</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">{</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">{</span><span> secrets.GH_TOKEN </span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">}</span><span class="token" style="color: rgb(212, 212, 212);">}</span><span>

</span>#### **6. Metrics Validation**
- **LLM Calls**: Only 1-2 chunks (10 tasks, chunk-size 200 = 1 chunk).  
- **Cache Hit Rate**: 100% on second run (no LLM calls).  
- **Emoji Relevance**:  
  - `📚` for ontology tasks  
  - `🖼️` for dashboard  
  - `💾` for caching  
  - `📦` for crate/docs  

**Risks**:
- LLM inconsistency (e.g., `🧠` for caching vs. `💾`)  
- Cache key collision (chunked terms vs. individual tasks)  

**Mitigation**:
- Use strict prompt template to reduce LLM variance  
- Hash individual terms for cache keys instead of chunked text  

---

### **Next Steps**

1. **Refine LLM Prompt Template**  
   - Use a stricter format to enforce consistency:  
     ```plaintext
     Summarize the following task into 3-5 emojis. Focus on software development, ontology, and task management.  
     Reply ONLY with emojis, no text.

     [TASK]
     ```

2. **Enhance Dioxus Dashboard**  
   - Add semantic clustering:  
     ```rust
     // task_dashboard/src/main.rs
     fn cluster_tasks(graph: &amp;Graph, emoji_map: &amp;HashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;f32&gt;&gt;) -&gt; HashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;Triple&gt;&gt; {
         let mut clusters = HashMap::new();
         for triple in graph.iter() {
             if let Some(emoji) = closest_emoji(&amp;triple, emoji_map) {
                 clusters.entry(emoji).or_insert_with(Vec::new).push(triple.clone());
             }
         }
         clusters
     }

     fn closest_emoji(triple: &amp;Triple, emoji_map: &amp;HashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;f32&gt;&gt;) -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {
         // Compute semantic similarity between task label and emoji embeddings
         Some("📚".to_string()) // Placeholder
     }
     ```

3. **Deploy Kanban Automation**  
   - Use the GitHub Actions workflow to sync issues with Kanban columns via emoji tags.  
   - Test with a sample issue:  
     ```bash
     gh issue create -t "Implement Redis caching" -b "Start with `vectorized.ttl` and expand to Redis" --label "📚"
     gh issue comment 107 --body "💾"
     ```

4. **Plan Redis Integration**  
   - Replace SQLite with Redis for distributed caching:  
     ```rust
     // task_manager_core/src/vectorizer.rs
     async fn call_llm(&amp;self, chunk: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt; {
         // Use Redis to cache LLM responses
         if let Some(cached) = self.redis.get(&amp;chunk)? {
             return Ok(cached);
         }
         let response = self.client.post("openai").json(&amp;json!({ "prompt": chunk })).send().await?;
         let emojis = parse_response(&amp;response)?;
         self.redis.set_ex(&amp;chunk, emojis, 86400)?; // 24h TTL
         Ok(emojis)
     }
     ```
